nodes.label: SAR Incident Manager plugin
nodes.rationale: Ports the Incident Manager tab from a legacy SAR TAK Electron app into a single native CloudTAK Vue plugin mounted at api/web/plugins/incident-manager. It adds a main-menu entry that opens a draggable FloatingPane with a left nav and Main / Task / Dashboard tabs, without CloudTAK core changes.

nodes.label: main and ccso branches
nodes.rationale: main is the public generic plugin (neutral labels and docs). ccso is the agency fork with Coconino/CCSO labels, default agencies, patrol-report wording, and reference PDFs.

nodes.label: Logger and Dashboard features
nodes.rationale: Create Mission makes a DataSync TAK mission with SAR fields, multi-format coordinates, and an optional Caltopo map. Logger covers initial information (MPS/CFS into mission logs), search area (LPB rings as mission features over CoT), urgency, scenarios, risk (objectives/strategies/tactics), and an Incident POST patrol report. Dashboard is a sortable combined log. CASIE, Task, and Wrap Up reuse or placeholder the source app.

nodes.label: Native mission log and CoT integration
nodes.rationale: All integration stays on host APIs: log writes use Subscription.load(guid).log.create, reads use sub.log.list({refresh:true}), and map features use mapStore.worker.conn.sendCOT with properties.dest set to the mission guid. Caltopo is the separate runtime contract window.__cloudtakCaltopo.createMap. Minimize-to-chip is plugin-owned so stock CloudTAK needs no PluginPane patch.

nodes.label: Local plugin checkout skips WEB_PLUGINS clone
nodes.rationale: The plugin is build-time only, not its own container: the CloudTAK image clones WEB_PLUGINS during docker compose build. Stacks such as tak-stack copy the whole CloudTAK tree into the image before bin/plugin.ts, so an existing api/web/plugins/incident-manager checkout is used instead of the pinned git URL and can be a stale branch.

nodes.label: Persist WEB_PLUGINS in compose override
nodes.rationale: cloudtak.sh update or a compose build that does not re-supply WEB_PLUGINS omits the plugin from the rebuilt image. Pinning the git URL in docker-compose.override.yml next to docker-compose.yml keeps it across rebuilds. Multiple plugins are a comma-separated list with no spaces.

nodes.label: Caltopo and D4H optional integrations
nodes.rationale: Create Caltopo map is skipped when window.__cloudtakCaltopo is absent. Organization and Resources tabs read roster data from CloudTAK KV keys such as d4h:roster and prompt to sync when the D4H plugin is not enabled.
